title: APRS Station Heard and Range
dataSources: APRS packets (`aprs:packet`), WSPR spots (`wspr:spot`), satellite passes (`satpass:prediction`), NOAA APT captures (`noaa:apt`), meteor-scatter pings (`meteorscatter:ping`), SSTV images (`sstv:image`).
app: Software-defined radio and ham-radio stations — APRS igate, WSPR beacon, NOAA weather-satellite (APT) receiver, meteor-scatter monitor, and SSTV decoder — logging to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=aprs:packet
| bin _time span=1d
| stats dc(callsign) as stations, max(distance_km) as farthest, count as packets by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts how many APRS stations your igate heard each day and the farthest one, a daily measure of your station's reach.
value: An igate's daily station count and range is the simplest health-and-reach metric, showing when conditions or antennas change.
implementation: Ingest APRS-IS packets from your igate; schedule daily and review stations heard and maximum range.
visualization: Column chart of daily stations heard with farthest-station overlay.
grandmaExplanation: It counts how many other radio stations your receiver picked up each day and the most distant one.
